primary_user: Social-care caseworkers filing benefit appeal packs
painful_workflow: Reconstructing which form version, deadline clock, and evidence checklist applied on the decision date
current_workaround: Scattered PDFs, email threads, and tribal knowledge in WhatsApp groups
imported_mechanism: Configuration drift detection + temporal fault trees
core_computation: Diff official rule versions between decision date and today; emit missing-evidence set required for a valid appeal
last_mile_action: Generate a dated appeal checklist + filing calendar holds
visible_transformation: From 2 hours of version archaeology to a dated, auditable appeal pack outline in under a minute
why_now: Public guidance pages mutate silently; scrapable change histories make drift detectable
kill_reason: May require careful sourcing of archived guidance pages
killer_demo: Paste decision date + letter → show guidance diff → emit required evidence list with timestamps
hard_to_fake_advantage: Auditable version-diff trail with timestamps

primary_user: Borough planning officers prioritizing inspection slots
painful_workflow: Manually reordering inspection queues under statutory deadlines and staff sickness
